bank.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
bank.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

facts.question: Are the mug and headphones identifiable in the edited image?
facts.present_when: Both the mug and headphones can be identified in the edited image.
facts.absent_when: The edited image confidently shows that one or both objects are not present.
facts.unknown_when: The edited image is unavailable or too unclear to determine whether either object is present.

facts.question: Is the mug visibly to the right of the headphones in the edited image?
facts.present_when: The mug is clearly positioned to the right of the headphones.
facts.absent_when: The mug is clearly not positioned to the right of the headphones.
facts.unknown_when: The objects' relative positions cannot be determined confidently.

facts.question: Compared with the source image, is there visible movement of the mug toward the right of the headphones?
facts.present_when: Comparison with the source shows the mug has moved toward the right of the headphones, whether or not it is now clearly to their right.
facts.absent_when: Comparison with the source confidently shows no movement of the mug toward the right of the headphones.
facts.unknown_when: The source-to-edited comparison does not provide enough evidence to determine whether the mug moved toward the right.

decisions.complete_when: F1 is present and F2 is present: both objects are identifiable and the mug is clearly to the right of the headphones.
decisions.partial_when: F1 is present, F2 is absent, and F3 is present: the mug has moved toward the requested position but is not clearly to the right.
decisions.absent_when: F1 is present, F2 is absent, and F3 is absent: the objects are identifiable, the requested position is not achieved, and there is confident evidence of no progress toward it.
decisions.unknown_when: The observations do not establish complete, partial, or absent fulfillment—for example, F1 is unknown, or F2 is absent while F3 is unknown.

audit.reason: F1–F3 are individually assessable, but the decision criteria omit a valid partial case: the mug can be visibly to the right (F2 present) while source comparison shows it did not move toward that position (F3 absent), so the requested change may be complete in the edited image without evidence it was performed. The criteria also classify F1 absent cases as unknown rather than allowing confident evidence that the requested change made no progress. Thus the outcomes are not fully judgeable under the saved criteria.
